description.value: Ma Now Thai Kitchen is a family-run neighbourhood Thai restaurant open since 2015, serving wholesome, fresh, and authentic Thai food in a casual dine-in setting. The name 'Ma Now' means lime in Thai — a nod to the bright, fresh flavours that define their cooking. Dishes range from familiar Thai classics to unique regional specialties, with many customizable for spice level and dietary needs.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (5 spaces) at 85m; rack (5 spaces) at 91m. Total: 10 spaces.

Vegetarian/vegan/GF options and takeout/pickup are confirmed by website text; no bike-specific amenities, Wi-Fi, washrooms, or water refill are mentioned anywhere on the site.
